- Next: run make check, then make lint and make test, then commit/push/task-switch if green.

- Validation passed: make check, make lint, make test. make test reported 243 passed / 16 skipped / 5 leaky; bug file .ralph/tasks/bugs/api-worker-reload-certificates-tests-are-leaky.md already exists, so no duplicate bug was created.
